title: Subagent中文用文件传输
trigger: subagent task with Chinese text or --input
rule: When launching subagent with Chinese/全角 content: write task description to _subagent_runs/{task}/input.txt, pass --input as file path, never pass Chinese inline in --input

title: Python inline 编码问题用 .py 文件
trigger: writing Python code with Chinese characters or full-width punctuation
rule: When Python code contains Chinese/全角/特殊字符: write to a .py file in temp/ first, then execute via bash python3 path/to/script.py. Never use inline triple-quoted strings with non-ASCII.

title: WSL bash grep timeout 用 Python
trigger: bash command that may run >10s or grep large output
rule: When running shell commands in WSL that might timeout (grep on large dirs, complex pipelines): use Python with os.popen() or subprocess.run() instead of inline bash. bash has 10s timeout in this environment.
